note: Canonical color system for SkillSynth. Every brand asset, cover, and UI surface derives from these named roles — no invented colors. Hex values are authoritative. Contrast ratios use WCAG 2.1 relative luminance.

paper-2.usage: Subtle surface: back covers, inset panels, soft dividers

card.usage: Derived: elevated surface (cards, inputs) lifted off paper

ink.usage: Primary text, headings, monochrome glyph strokes

clay.usage: Muted helper text (large sizes only), placeholder tone
clay.note: Below AA for small text — decorative/muted use is display-size only

ochre.usage: Primary accent: mark ring, seed dot, stage dots, large display accents, hairlines, focus ring base
ochre.note: Display/large-text or decoration only on paper — not small body text

ochre-deep.usage: Accent text (AA on paper), wordmark 'Synth', buttons, links, marker underlines, ochre covers rendered readable

sage.usage: Secondary accent: serene fields, leaf-stage mid tone, sage band, display accents
sage.note: Decorative/display only — sage-deep for text on light

sage-deep.usage: Sprout stem + leaves, status-critical sage text (AA), deep sage type

ok.note: AA boundary — prefer ink-soft or sage-deep for critical copy; ok for large + UI

ok-deep.usage: Derived: success text for AA compliance

ok-soft.usage: Derived: success surface tint of paper

warning.usage: Status warning (warm amber) — derived warm, AA on paper

warning-deep.usage: Derived: warning text on paper-2 / interactive states

danger-deep.usage: Derived: destructive text on paper-2, destructive buttons

line.usage: Hairline border / grid / route dashes on paper

line-strong.usage: Stronger hairline: focus borders, larger grid lines, rule underlines

ring.usage: Focus ring (=ochre-deep, exported for app parity)

focus-glow.usage: Focus glow (thin + subtle only — no neon)
